scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 playable with substantial friction; 7 good observed experience with meaningful rough edges; 10 exceptional across assessed mobile play. Subjective quality, not mission outcome or a device certification.

reasons.overallMobile: Two coherent complete missions, helpful assists and clear feedback; target visibility and turning/reload interpretation remain friction. Wins alone do not determine grade.
reasons.controls: Two-contact MOVE/FIRE drag worked in both patrol samples, scene turns and DASH responded, AIM visibly zoomed. Wrong turn, a NO IMPACT burst and interrupted holds limit confidence in sustained combat comfort.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, three coil stages and uplink formed a legible varied short loop. Assisted routes carried most traversal; free navigation, broader tactics and prolonged challenge not assessed.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive rainy teal station, distinctive relay machinery, readable weapon/impact changes and restrained results screen. Audio and hardware smoothness not assessed.
reasons.usability: Large labeled touch controls, changing route/approach action, planning map and fresh-start reset supported completion. Reload transition required observation and an extra wait.
reasons.readability: Primary objective, health/ammo and completion checks clear; small distant patrols, dark structures, tiny signs and overlapping threat cards reduced fast scene comprehension.
